_metadata.purpose: Simulated test failures to inject architecture drift
_metadata.inject_at: After D-05 implementation complete, before D-06 as-built comparison

test_failures.error_message: Payment not refunded after order cancellation
test_failures.expected_behavior: When order is cancelled, payment should be automatically refunded
test_failures.actual_behavior: Order status changed to CANCELLED but payment remains COMPLETED (charged)

root_cause_analysis.description: During testing, discovered that order cancellation doesn't trigger payment refund. This wasn't considered in initial design but is required for business logic.
root_cause_analysis.impact: HIGH - Users charged for cancelled orders

new_functions.description: Process payment refund for cancelled order

test_failures.implementation_fix: Added RefundPayment function to PaymentService, updated CancelOrder to call it

test_failures.expected_behavior: GetOrderStatus returns complete order information including payment status
test_failures.actual_behavior: GetOrderStatus only returns order fields (order_id, status, items) but not payment information

root_cause_analysis.description: Initial requirements didn't specify that order status should include payment information. During testing/stakeholder review, this was identified as necessary for customer service and user experience.
root_cause_analysis.impact: MEDIUM - Incomplete information to users/customer service

modified_functions.change: Add dependency on GetPaymentStatus from PaymentService

new_interfaces.purpose: OrderService queries PaymentService for payment status to include in order status response

test_failures.implementation_fix: Added payment_status_query interface, OrderService.GetOrderStatus now queries PaymentService

test_failures.error_message: duplicate key value violates unique constraint 'orders_order_id_key'
test_failures.test_code: with ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor: futures = [executor.submit(create_order, user_id=1) for _ in range(10)]
test_failures.expected_behavior: Concurrent order creation requests create unique orders
test_failures.actual_behavior: Race condition causes duplicate order_ids to be generated, database constraint violation

root_cause_analysis.description: Order ID generation uses timestamp-based approach which fails under concurrent load. Need atomic uniqueness validation before order creation.
root_cause_analysis.impact: HIGH - System crashes under concurrent load

new_functions.description: Atomic check to ensure order_id is unique before creation

test_failures.implementation_fix: Added ValidateOrderUniqueness function with database lock, CreateOrder calls it first

instructions_for_agent_b.when_to_inject: After completing D-05 (service implementation), before starting D-06 (as-built comparison)
instructions_for_agent_b.how_to_inject: Present these test failures as if they came from running integration tests. Agent B should implement the fixes (adding new functions/interfaces) to make tests pass.
instructions_for_agent_b.critical: After implementing fixes, Agent B's implementation will NOT match the original architecture. This creates the drift that D-06.5 should detect and resolve.
